{{DISPLAYTITLE:Bibliography}}
{{Lean theorem prover map}}

Every work cited on the pages of this edition, listed once, with the pages that cite it in reading order. There are 277: 86 papers and books; 114 items of Lean documentation and source, 52 of them parts of the reference manual; 64 project pages and announcements; and 13 press articles and encyclopedia entries.

Two citations are taken to be one work when they share a DOI, an arXiv number or a web address. A preprint and its published version are listed apart when the pages cite them apart, and so is each version of a document that changes with Lean: a chapter of the reference manual cited in its edition for Lean 4.34.0 on some pages and for Lean 4.35.0 on others appears twice, once under each address.

Where pages cite one work in different forms, the form given here is the fullest, and a note says what differs when it is more than punctuation, capitals or the sections a page names. The 19 works that were not read, or were read only in part, are marked; [[Lean theorem prover/Sources|the sources page]] says what each one carries and what carries it instead.
